output.rule: Use 不是……而是…… only to correct a conventional or mistaken idea with an unexpected alternative. Put the subject before 不是……而是…… when both alternatives have the same subject.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: 不是……而是…… must refute a mistaken or expected idea and give its correction; <first alternative> is not conventionally related to <second alternative>.

examples.explanation: 不是商店而是学校: 商店 is not conventionally related to 对教育有好处, so this is not a correction relationship for 不是……而是…….
不是画画儿，而是祭拜: 画画儿 is not a conventional activity related to 寺庙, so 不是……而是…… does not fit here.
他不是在搬家 → 他不再搬家: 搬家 is not conventionally related to 看文章, so do not use 不是……而是…….
不是孟子喜欢这个城市，而是他喜欢这个城市的人 → 孟子不是喜欢这个城市，而是喜欢这个城市的人: put the subject 孟子 before 不是……而是…….

output.not_an_error: Do not flag a sentence that genuinely corrects a mistaken or conventional idea with an unexpected alternative. Do not use this pattern merely to connect two unrelated actions, places, or ideas.
